description: This file contains the implementation of a KuksaClient in Rust that interacts with a gRPC-based data broker, providing methods for getting, setting, subscribing to data entries, and managing metadata within the Kuksa data environment.

classes.name: KuksaClient
classes.description: A client for interacting with a Kuksa data broker, supporting operations like get, set, and subscribe to data entries and metadata.

methods.name: new(uri: Uri) -> Self
methods.description: Creates a new KuksaClient with the specified URI.

methods.name: set(&mut self, entry: DataEntry, _fields: Vec<i32>) -> Result<(), ClientError>
methods.description: Sets a data entry with specified fields asynchronously.

methods.name: get( &mut self, path: &str, view: proto::v1::View, _fields: Vec<i32>, ) -> Result<Vec<DataEntry>, ClientError>
methods.description: Retrieves data entries for a given path, view, and fields asynchronously.

methods.name: get_metadata(&mut self, paths: Vec<&str>) -> Result<Vec<DataEntry>, ClientError>
methods.description: Fetches metadata entries for specified paths.

methods.name: get_current_values( &mut self, paths: Vec<String>, ) -> Result<Vec<DataEntry>, ClientError>
methods.description: Fetches current value entries for specified paths.

methods.name: get_target_values( &mut self, paths: Vec<&str>, ) -> Result<Vec<DataEntry>, ClientError>
methods.description: Retrieves target actuator values for specified paths.

methods.name: set_current_values( &mut self, datapoints: HashMap<String, proto::v1::Datapoint>, ) -> Result<(), ClientError>
methods.description: Sets current values for multiple data points.

methods.name: set_target_values( &mut self, datapoints: HashMap<String, proto::v1::Datapoint>, ) -> Result<(), ClientError>
methods.description: Sets target actuator values for multiple data points.

methods.name: set_metadata( &mut self, metadatas: HashMap<String, proto::v1::Metadata>, ) -> Result<(), ClientError>
subscribe_current_values( &mut self, paths: Vec<&str>, ) -> Result<tonic::Streaming<proto::v1::SubscribeResponse>, ClientError>
methods.description: Subscribes to updates for current values of specified paths.

methods.name: subscribe( &mut self, paths: Vec<&str>, ) -> Result<tonic::Streaming<proto::v1::SubscribeResponse>, ClientError>
methods.description: Subscribes to current value updates (alias for subscribe_current_values).

methods.name: subscribe_target_values( &mut self, paths: Vec<&str>, ) -> Result<tonic::Streaming<proto::v1::SubscribeResponse>, ClientError>
methods.description: Subscribes to target value updates for specified paths.

methods.name: subscribe_metadata( &mut self, paths: Vec<String>, ) -> Result<tonic::Streaming<proto::v1::SubscribeResponse>, ClientError>
methods.description: Subscribes to metadata updates for specified paths.
